requirement: The system shall ingest handwritten, image, spreadsheet, and PDF inputs, automatically parse supported files, and convert recognized formulas or tables into normalized LaTeX code.

The system shall support user registration, login/authentication, password recovery, and user account information management, including credential validation and failure feedback for invalid login attempts.
The system shall manage projects and collaboration groups, including creation, browsing, joining, member management, shared resources, and role-based access for owners and collaborators.
The system shall manage a version tree for project history, including historical version lookup, child-version creation, file editing, restoration, download, and version comments.

The system shall allow users to edit generated LaTeX content, render a real-time preview, and export outputs as PDF, LaTeX source, PNG, or JPEG artifacts, with compatibility to mainstream LaTeX workflows.
The system shall persist and retrieve user, group, project, version, file-path, parsed-content, workspace, edit-time, and comment data according to the database schema constraints.
The system shall provide browser-based user interfaces for the main workflows and support modern browsers, including WebSocket-capable clients for real-time web interaction.

The system shall expose external HTTP/REST APIs for user, project, file, collaboration, preview, version, and comment operations, and define internal service interfaces for verification, storage, recognition, LaTeX generation, rendering, collaboration, and version control.
The system shall protect sensitive data and defend relevant web inputs against common attacks, including encryption-related privacy handling and protections against SQL injection, XSS, and CSRF.
